text:
The Sound Approaches...

The sound

approaches. The soul becomes young again

Submitting to the overwhelming whisper.

In dreams, breathless, I press against my lips

Your passing hand.


I dream I am a boy again, a lover again,

I see a ravine and wild grasses.

And in those grasses a thorny thicket

In the mist of evening.


Through the flowers, leaves and thorny branches

The old house looks into my heart

The sky peers again, blushing from side to side,

Your window.

This voice

is yours and I would give life and pain

For its incomprehensible sound,

Though in the dream I press against my lips

Your beloved passing hand.

May 2

1912

Version by Jorge Bustamante García

translation.title: I Accept Everything There Was...
